decision.note: Priority is inherited from the AI-Ques portfolio entry and is not a repository-quality score.

strengths: P004 is explicitly marked prototype_only and separates public character chat from research-side inference in its documented architecture.
Observed user/model rendering paths use textContent; observed innerHTML uses are fixed templates rather than user/model free text.
BYOK API keys are scoped to sessionStorage and the UI discloses browser-side key exposure risk.
The NVWA fallback is explicitly labelled a Character Skill draft rather than pretending to be a completed research distillation.
VIA 24 and Interpersonal Circumplex theory boundaries are documented without falsely claiming strict MECE for VIA.
P00 Quality Gate and GitHub Pages deployment both passed on the audited repository HEAD.

evidence: p004/README.md, p004/module-manifest.json and p004/NVWA_CONTRACT.md clearly separate character chat, optional distillation, memory, Observer and prototype/non-diagnostic boundaries.
The intended production/admin boundary is documented, although the public static implementation does not yet enforce it.
The audited HEAD passed JS syntax and repository structure checks.
P004 has no runtime/browser behavior test covering creator flow, API branches, storage lifecycle, Observer import, safety override or chat rendering.
The immediate-risk override is implemented primarily as fixed keyword matching rather than a validated safety classifier.
BYOK keys stay in current-tab sessionStorage and the UI discloses the browser-side key risk.
Characters, transcripts, relationship memory and Observer/safety evidence persist in localStorage/IndexedDB without a unified clear/retention control.
P005 narrative/chat data is imported into P004 Observer without an explicit opt-in gate.
The static admin view is enabled by ?admin=1 and therefore is a demo affordance, not authorization.
The runtime is dependency-light and does not load third-party JS packages from CDNs.
All five observed GitHub Action references use mutable version tags rather than immutable commit SHAs.
P004 identifies the NVWA protocol as xmg2024/nvwa-skill@main, which can drift over time.
P004 is a static application with module-manifest metadata and no package dependency installation step, making basic local reproduction straightforward.
Exact behavior can still vary with user-supplied OpenAI-compatible endpoints, browser CORS/private-network behavior, and the mutable NVWA @main reference.
GitHub Pages deployment and the P00 Quality Gate passed on the audited HEAD.
The repository has no LICENSE or changelog/release provenance surface, and main branch protection is verified disabled.
P004 README documents BYOK, NVWA limitations, local Skill Vault, long-term memory intent, Observer and safety boundaries.
The UI contains API test diagnostics and prototype/admin caveats.
Persistent transcript/Observer retention and cross-P005 secondary use are not yet presented as explicit user choices before processing.
p004/app.js is approximately 50 KB and combines Character Studio, persistence, IndexedDB, memory, Observer, safety, admin rendering and API orchestration.
P004 regression coverage is dominated by static regex/structure invariants rather than executable behavior tests.
The repository has README and a live homepage, but GitHub description is null and topics are empty.
LICENSE, SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, CITATION.cff and CHANGELOG.md were not present at the audited HEAD.

reasons: AI-Ques is already public and this audit found no committed API keys, real user transcripts or private-repository metadata in the reviewed P004 surface.
P004 is explicitly marked as a prototype; public-ok here only means no new recorded publication blocker, not patentability, ownership or legal clearance.

findings.title: Cross-module P005 evidence import lacks explicit opt-in
evidence: p004/app.js importP005() reads bjtu.p005.state.v1 and converts P005 profile/open responses and user chat into P004 Observer evidence.
backgroundObserve() invokes importP005() without a consent-state check.
The page discloses BACKGROUND OBSERVER but does not expose an explicit allow/deny control for this secondary use.
findings.recommendation: Default P005 import to off, add explicit opt-in/withdrawal, and only import after consent.

findings.title: Persistent P004 data lacks a unified clear/retention control
evidence: P004 persists characters, threads, memory and Observer data in localStorage and distilled skills in IndexedDB.
The API settings modal can clear the BYOK key, but no clear-all control for P004 transcripts/memory/observer/skills was found.
findings.recommendation: Add a visible clear-P004-local-data control covering localStorage and IndexedDB, with explicit scope and confirmation; consider retention/session-only options.

findings.title: Static ?admin=1 research view is not an authorization boundary
evidence: p004/app.js enables adminMode when the URL query parameter admin=1 is present.
p004/index.html labels clinical/status signals admin only while also acknowledging that production requires server-side RBAC.
findings.recommendation: Treat the Pages surface as research-preview/demo only; real admin-only access requires authenticated backend RBAC and server-side field filtering.

findings.title: Safety override is a keyword heuristic, not a production safety agent
evidence: p004/app.js defines a fixed SAFETY_TERMS list and urgentSafety() checks whether any term is contained in user text.
This mechanism cannot reliably cover euphemisms, English/multilingual expressions, negation/context or broader risk semantics.
findings.recommendation: Keep the client keyword path as a fallback, but describe it as best-effort; production should use a dedicated safety classifier/policy layer with evaluated coverage.

findings.title: P004 core behavior is not exercised by automated runtime tests
evidence: .github/workflows/quality-gate.yml checks p004/app.js and p004/api-client.js syntax.
tests/structure.mjs asserts many P004 strings and structural invariants but does not execute the creator/chat/storage/API behavior.
No dedicated P004 runtime/browser smoke test was found.
findings.recommendation: Add P004 behavior tests for creator flow, API success/failure, storage lifecycle, consent/import, safety override and rendering; split pure logic where needed for zero-dependency Node tests.

findings.title: Mutable GitHub Action and NVWA references weaken supply-chain reproducibility
evidence: Observed workflows use actions/checkout@v6, actions/configure-pages@v5, actions/upload-pages-artifact@v4 and actions/deploy-pages@v4.
repo-auditor's immutable-ref rule classifies these tag references as unpinned.
P004 uses protocolVersion xmg2024/nvwa-skill@main.
findings.recommendation: Pin reviewed GitHub Actions to full commit SHAs with version comments and pin NVWA protocol to a concrete commit/release.

findings.title: P004 runtime is concentrated in one large application file
evidence: p004/app.js is approximately 50 KB and contains Character Studio, persistence, IndexedDB, NVWA orchestration, memory, Observer, safety, admin rendering and API settings.
findings.recommendation: Incrementally split pure logic and module responsibilities before adding further character-world features.

findings.title: Local fallback memory is closer to truncated transcript storage than summarized retrieval memory
evidence: Without a memory backend, maybeRemember() stores a whitespace-normalized user input truncated to roughly 190 characters as a durable memory item.
No embedding/salience/relevance retrieval is used in the static BYOK fallback.
findings.recommendation: Label current local memory as prototype memory blocks and later add summary/salience/retrieval before making stronger long-term-memory claims.

findings.title: Public repository has no explicit software license
evidence: The audited repository root does not contain LICENSE and GitHub metadata reports license=null.
findings.recommendation: Owner should choose and add an appropriate license; repo-auditor must not choose licensing terms automatically.

findings.title: Main branch quality gate is not enforced by branch protection
evidence: GitHub branch metadata for main reports protected=false and required status checks enforcement off.
findings.recommendation: When moving beyond rapid prototype mode, enable a ruleset/branch protection and require the P00 Quality Gate before merge.

limitations: The repo-auditor network collector could not run directly inside the execution container because outbound DNS is disabled; equivalent collector fields were gathered through the authorized GitHub connector and the structured report is validated by repo-auditor CI.
No real OpenAI-compatible, FreeLLMAPI or NVWA backend request was executed as part of this audit.
No browser-level accessibility or cross-browser test was run.
No claim is made that P004's heuristic personality/clinical inference is psychometrically validated.
Owner-supplied patent, employer/client/PI request, background-IP and ownership questions were not collected in this P004-focused pass.
recheck_triggers: Any change to P004 Observer import or cross-module P005 data reuse.
Any change to BYOK secret handling or arbitrary endpoint support.
Introduction of a real backend/admin authentication layer.
Changes to safety classification or crisis-response behavior.
Changes to NVWA protocol pinning or distillation execution.
Major refactor of p004/app.js or addition of runtime/browser tests.
First formal research data collection or production deployment.
